ModMetaData.name: Fire Wasp Art Override
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description: Replaces sarg.alphaanimals' AA_FireWasp art (all three lifeStages share one texPath) with custom generated Pyrelands-themed art (pyrelands_firewasp_v3). The dessicated-corpse texture (AA_Dessicated_FireWasp) stays on donor art. LABEL/ART ONLY - no defName touched, no Defs, no Patches, loose Textures/ only, same relative path (Things/Pawn/Animal/AA_FireWasp/AA_FireWasp_<facing>) the donor uses so this mod's later load order wins the same-path resolution.
